question: State what sets the Parallel signup credit (up to USD 80) and when it expires, from a real sign-up at https://platform.parallel.ai/signup (an rq:operator step).
why: The pricing page says 'Earn up to $80 at signup + $5 in free credits per month' and names no condition; the vendor's comparison article says a card is needed only for the monthly credit, and the sign-up page takes an email address or a Google account. What sets the amount, whether a work email address is needed, and the expiry are behind a sign-up; third-party reports differ on the amount and the expiry, and none is first-party. Until it is read, crawler-scraper/parallel records the amount as up to USD 80 and its condition as unverified.
